saw.short: Robert Pattinson announced as the next James Bond
saw.headline: *Robert Pattinson* announced as the next James Bond
saw.what: Amazon MGM Studios confirmed on Monday that Robert Pattinson, 40, will play James Bond, announced on the official 007 Instagram account, per Deadline, Variety and Metro. Denis Villeneuve is directing and Steven Knight is writing. Metro says production is expected to start in 2027, with no exact dates announced.
saw.why: The biggest casting reveal of the year. Last week’s rumours are now confirmed.
saw.source: Deadline, 16 Nov; Variety, 16 Nov; Metro, 16 Nov

saw.short: I'm A Celebrity opens with a day-one head-to-head trial
saw.headline: *I’m A Celebrity* opens with a day-one head-to-head trial
saw.what: I’m A Celebrity returned on Monday with a launch-night twist: the slowest celebrity in each group faced a head-to-head elimination trial. AJ Odudu lost to Claire Sweeney and was sent home. Fans and writers speculate she may return as a late arrival, but ITV hasn’t said so. The Sun reports viewers compared the format to The Traitors.
saw.why: The first episode already has a talking point. Social chatter will run all week.
saw.source: Digital Spy, 16 Nov; The Sun, 16 Nov; LADbible, 16 Nov

saw.short: The GTA VI album tracklist has reportedly leaked
saw.headline: The *GTA VI album tracklist* has reportedly leaked
saw.what: NME reports the full 34-track tracklist for GTA VI: The Album has leaked online, after a record-store employee reportedly sold a vinyl copy early. It lists Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, Zara Larsson and Rina Sawayama. Rockstar announced the album in September but hasn’t published the tracklist. Game and album are due on Thursday 19 Nov.
saw.why: A music story riding the biggest game launch of the year. The tracklist is unofficial.

saw.short: Oasis skip their Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
saw.headline: *Oasis* skip their Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
saw.what: Oasis were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame on Saturday without any band member attending, NME reports. Liam Gallagher posted on X: “It’s too far to be going for the night.” Noel was at London’s Royal Festival Hall for the EFG London Jazz Festival. The ceremony airs on 8 December on ABC.
saw.why: A classic Gallagher moment. Oasis stories always travel in the UK.

saw.short: King Charles agrees cheese and beans is the best jacket potato
saw.headline: King Charles agrees *cheese and beans* is the best jacket potato
saw.what: King Charles met jacket-potato van SpudBros on a visit to Preston on Monday, and appeared to agree with brothers Jacob and Harley Nelson that cheese and beans is the best filling, per a video they posted and Metro. Metro says the video has nearly 2 million views. It was his first visit to the city since becoming King.
saw.why: A royal moment with an easy, funny hook. Brands got there by being themselves.

saw.short: Queen release a reworked Christmas single
saw.headline: *Queen* release a reworked Christmas single
saw.what: Queen have released a reworked version of “Thank God It’s Christmas”, with new parts from Brian May and Roger Taylor around Freddie Mercury’s original vocal. It was first played on Radio 2 on Monday. A limited 7-inch follows on 18 December, the day the Christmas No.1 tracking week starts, per Official Charts.
saw.why: The Christmas No.1 race has its first big name. Expect heritage-act chat.

platform.headline: Instagram adds *Amazon affiliate links* for creators
platform.what: Instagram is adding Amazon affiliate links, letting eligible creators attach up to 30 products to a Reel and 20 to a feed post, Social Media Today reports from an Instagram press release. Creators see the commission rate per item. The report doesn’t say which markets get it.
platform.why: Another route to shoppable creator content. UK availability isn’t confirmed.

platform.short: YouTube announces GTA VI launch-week activations
platform.headline: YouTube announces *GTA VI launch-week* activations
platform.what: YouTube says it will run a 24-hour global launch-day livestream with top gaming creators, plus a GTA VI-themed logo, limited-edition “Wanted Stars” digital gifts and a Shorts effect. Social Media Today dates the announcement to 12 Nov. The livestream is global, and the report doesn’t list markets for the other items.
platform.why: Platforms are turning game launches into their own events. Expect a feed takeover on Thursday.

platform.short: LinkedIn opens connected-TV ads to UK advertisers
platform.headline: LinkedIn opens *connected-TV ads* to UK advertisers
platform.what: LinkedIn has opened its connected-TV ads to UK advertisers, with partners including LG, Paramount+ and Titan OS, PPC Land reports from LinkedIn’s own post. The UK is the third market after the US and Canada. LinkedIn’s effectiveness claims come from US and Canada campaigns, not the UK.
platform.why: A new TV-screen route for B2B. The performance numbers aren’t UK results.
platform.source: PPC Land, 12 Nov; Social Media Today, 12 Nov
